architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. Static assets in public/. Tailwind CSS for styling. React Router for navigation. No state management lib (useState/useReducer suffice).

tickets.title: Build Landing Page (src/pages/Landing.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch screen to React. Extract hero section, marquee, CTA buttons. Reuse existing Tailwind classes. Mobile-first responsive.

tickets.title: Build Portfolio Home (src/pages/PortfolioHome.jsx)
tickets.description: Implement portfolio grid. Extract reusable ProjectCard component. Glass-morphism effects via Tailwind backdrop-blur. Dynamic project data from local JSON (src/data/projects.json).
acceptance_criteria: Filter tags functional (UI only, no backend)

tickets.title: Build Work/Dev Page (src/pages/Work.jsx)
tickets.description: Implement work timeline. Extract TimelineItem component. Scroll-triggered animations via IntersectionObserver. Data from src/data/work.json.

tickets.title: Build About Page (src/pages/About.jsx)
tickets.description: Implement split layout. Extract SkillMarquee component. Circular progress bars via SVG. Data from src/data/skills.json.
acceptance_criteria: Split layout collapses to single column <768px
SVG progress bars animate on scroll

tickets.title: Build Services Page (src/pages/Services.jsx)
tickets.description: Implement service cards. Extract ServiceCard component. Hover tilt effect via CSS transform. Data from src/data/services.json.
acceptance_criteria: Service icons render from local assets

tickets.title: Build Contact Page (src/pages/Contact.jsx)
tickets.description: Implement form. Extract Input/Textarea components. Form validation via HTML5 attributes. Submit handler logs to console (placeholder).

tickets.title: Extract Shared Components (src/components/)
tickets.description: Identify reusable components across screens. Implement: Button, Badge, Footer, Navbar. Use Tailwind variants for styling. Prop types via JSDoc.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Implement main app shell. Add React Router routes for all pages. Navbar links active state via NavLink. 404 page fallback. Lazy load pages via React.lazy.
acceptance_criteria: All routes load without full page refresh
Navbar active state updates on route change
